message: 鑑賞会

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, for all your excuses, you actually took photos of us」
Photo data displays one after another on the laptop's LCD screen.

name: Azel
message: 「...It was by chance. It was not intentional」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, the Vice President is reading something」

name: Synn
message: 「The title is 'Bliss,' huh. She really does have a meltingly happy look on her face」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-Why do you have a photo like this!?」

name: Azel
message: 「I took it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And zoom in」

name: Misa
message: 「Waaah! No, not this one!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could it be she was reading a naughty book or something?」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's grinning while reading a porn mag」

name: Misa
message: 「I am not Sakura-kun, so I am not! Delete!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. Talk about tyrannical, or rather, a false accusation」

name: Azel
message: 「Do not delete it without permission」

name: Paqy
message: 「So it really was a porn mag」

name: Misa
message: 「It is not! Please do not take private photos like this!」

name: Azel
message: 「It was a photo I even went so far as to give a title」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, that's tyrannical」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp. B-But, that's not it, um, well」

name: Azel
message: 「How barbaric」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel. Don't worry. It's still here. Sally-chan, hold Misa down」

name: Sally
message: 「Okaay」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-What are you doing! Let go, I said let go!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Open the Trash... there it is, there it is, and zoom in」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It says 『Maiden in Love ★ Doki-Doki! Heart-Pounding Summer Vacation』」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahh, this really is embarrassing」

name: Azel
message: 「What is embarrassing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, isn't this Tinun?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mochimochi doesn't do delivery, so it's not that... Which of the two is it?」

name: Azel
message: 「It is Jangara」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You can really tell, huh. Even I mix them up sometimes」

name: Azel
message: 「Of course I can tell. Their demeanor is different」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even I can tell them apart, you know. This is Omake-san!」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if that's something to brag about」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh! This one's me! Super cute!」

name: Sally
message: 「You're a pretty good guy!」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not like I took it because I wanted to...」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, didn't Sally-chan used to avoid Azel?」

name: Sally
message: 「Ahh, now that you mention it, I feel like that did happen」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is what they call that saying, isn't it. If you mix with sake, you turn red... Huh? Why would a phrase about turning red from drinking alcohol apply here?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's quite a complicated misunderstanding」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying I'm being influenced by you lot!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Lately, Azel-san has started nibbling on them too, so my share of the three o'clock snacks has decreased」

name: Azel
message: 「I―Is there a problem with that. They are put out to be eaten, and I am part of your grou―」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're so stingy」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, it's not that I'm lamenting my share getting smaller. I am merely stating a fact」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel? What's wrong?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's nothing... I'm going home」

name: Ria
message: 「You're sweating so much! Are you feeling sick somewhere?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's nothing!」
Azel suddenly stood up and left the Student Council room.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「She's gone...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Where's Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「She was already gone by the time I stepped out」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could it be...」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you have an idea what's going on?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「U-Um, well, Azel-san is a girl, after all. My guidebook said all sorts of things happen because of that」

name: Synn
message: 「Because she's a girl?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, it can be really rough for some people. Though, does it come on that suddenly?」

name: Ria
message: 「Depending on the person, they can suddenly start feeling sick」

name: Misa
message: 「For someone like Shio, it seems really heavy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's such a pain, isn't it...」
The atmosphere makes it feel like I can't really chime in.
I'm just a lonely boy all by myself.
